pieces.content:
There is no ∗∗∗∗ in this Net
or detritus and it is
not useful when things shiver
or disappear and there is
no way to ask or reply.
This is not a record of
an aerosol line of thought.
It is not a forgetful
payload. And you tidied our
machinery by saying
it is eusocial but I
don’t want to know about how
to absolve hungry termites
in a middleware of blue
exceptions. I want to be
reddened and fed away from
the tasteless cellulose of
knowing or whatever it’s
made up in. Maybe a cup.
I want to remember the
actually yes there always
sentiment of waterless
hunting in the world before
it is swallowed by a you
sound and its young petrichor.
